payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning': the couple needs Brazil's legal requirements, documents, civil versus religious options and Australian recognition before committing to a city or venue, so the Wedded Concierge invitations appear only after those sections, at the cost question and once the post turns to venues and planning. The Wedded Advisor is positioned for planning only, never the legal paperwork. Each subtext carries one brand-facts reassurance: fee in writing (primary), single point of contact (secondary), AUD quotes, time zone and inclusions in writing (closing). No figures, 'free', perks, Privileges or availability wording. All four tracked links already appear once each with correct UTMs, so no copy change is made. A printable Brazil document checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
